candidate: groupwise symmetric INT8 lm-head on top of vLLM per-block FP8 backbone
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, max_num_seqs=1, batch-1 greedy decode
mechanism: Quantize only the 248320x1024 tied output projection to signed INT8 with one FP16 scale per contiguous K group, then fuse dequantization with the M=1 FP32 reduction. Keep vLLM scheduling, CUDA graphs, Marlin FP8 backbone, attention and recurrent kernels unchanged.

screen.selection: group32 retained because its smaller quantization groups gave the best output-stability/speed tradeoff

quality.contract: bounded task-quality pass, explicitly lossy and not a broad quality-equivalence claim

technical_repairs: Reduced Triton BLOCK_N after the first schedule exceeded SM89 shared-memory capacity.
Pinned VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 because WSL exposes no UVA to the V2 runner.
Pinned VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 because the system CUDA 12.0 nvcc cannot compile FlashInfer's CUDA-13-era --compress-mode=size option.
decision: PROMOTE only as a calibrated lossy max_num_seqs=1 latency policy point. Do not replace the strict exact head or the native multi-sequence vLLM path.
